fields.Name: C1 -> C1.3
fields.Description: Gate G4.3 (owner PR 5, phase 4, dataset C1, criterion C1.3): every control-path transition of a Model Development Agent session is one MJ: Agent Decision Logs row, and the log reproduces the session. On the truth suite's W1-signal world one session spans the approval boundary (run 1 presents the plan, the D5-46 person approves as their own client save, the resumed run 2 builds): decision rows = transitions (100%: each draft, profile and Plan step, and a request-build and a report row per build), all with run 1's SessionRunID, Step 1..n contiguous across both runs, each PayloadHash the previous ResultingPayloadHash; AgentSessionReplay.Replay reproduces the last ResultingPayloadHash with 0 new MJ: AI Prompt Runs (1 of 1), and a copy of the log with one logged PromptRunID swapped for a missing prompt run is replay-incomplete naming it; an update, a delete and a client create of a decision row are refused; a new modeling request after the report starts a new SessionRunID. Server transport (the agent runs as the D5-46 person); spends LLM money. Mutations (unit attacks): let the guard allow an update -> attack 3 red; skip the hash comparison in Replay -> attack 5 red; key Step on AgentRunID -> attack 4 red. Run budget 30 min (MaxExecutionTimeMS): three orchestrator runs and one W1 build on the sidecar.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: One session across the approval boundary writes one decision row per transition in one chain, and replay reproduces its plan with no LLM call.
